conclusion: The MISEV2023 guideline (ev-misev2023-quality-framework) supports the high-level reviewer conclusions that orthogonal EV characterization, defined source-cell controls, validated intact-EV release and potency assays, production reporting, and in‑vivo controls are recommended best practices prior to advancing an intranasal EV product. Therefore the program‑specific assertions that those items are absent cannot be independently corroborated from the supplied evidence, and a regulatory/advancement determination based on their presence/adequacy cannot be made from the provided record.
